title: What's happening, today and this week

criteria.text: A row returns the posts whose start time falls inside its window, soonest first
criteria.note: Since #871 one read, `browse_happening` (migration 20261016170000), returns `browse_feed`'s posts soonest first for the week and the weekend, each with its own limit, and `getHappening` cuts today at tonight; visibility, scope and order are `browse_feed`'s [V]. The rows show at the top of the posts-only Type view (`BrowseSurface.tsx`, #881) [V]. Reviewed no: #266 has no `Reviewed by:`, #815 and #871 are review-skipped. Shipped: green on 2a0d7f7c, b7766901, 0ace38da [V]. Checked: loader test is `[guards F091.1 partial]` (`load-withheld.test.ts:204`, each row asks for the window); the SQL tests in `tests/migrations-browse-feed.test.ts` and the `browse_happening` DB test (#871) are unmarked (#612) [V]. Smoked: smoke-live scheduled run 41093000135 on main 09ffba30 (2026-10-30) was green and opened explore at 390 and 1280 for signed-out, stranger, member, owner and operator personas, after every merge here (runs 10-24 to 10-29 green too); it loads the route, it does not tap [V].

criteria.text: A row returns only posts that start inside its window
criteria.note: #815 (change #814, 2026-10-16, no scenario change) made the window hold a post that is on during it, so a post that started earlier and has not ended appears in 'today' (`coalesce(ends_at, starts_at) >= p_starts_from`; test 'a time window holds a post that is on during it'); #871's `browse_happening` and #914's `post_current_until` keep that rule [V]. That contradicts 'only posts whose start time falls inside'; the scenario has no ruling for it. Routed to `scope-scenario` (amend to 'on during the window'); nothing filed.

criteria.note: Rows are a function of the route's metro and area and the clock only; the posts-only view is the word `posts` in `?q=` (#881; an old `?view=updates` link still reads as Posts), so it travels in the link, and #942 writes the URL in place [V]. Checked: #1065 (2026-10-26) added `[guards F091.5]` in `load-withheld.test.ts:217` ('the same link reopens the same rows: same scope and clock give the same read whatever the session seed, and the old ?q=updates link still means posts'), seen failing with a per-call random added to the row limit and with the legacy updates word no longer read [V]. 'Same rows' holds within the hour the windows are bound to [A]. Reviewed no (#266 no line, #881 and #942 yes; #1065 tests only, review-skipped). criteria.text: A series appears at most once in a row
criteria.note: `browse_feed`, `browse_happening` and the 2026-10-26 `browse_nearby` rewrite (#1086) have no grouping by a series [V migrations 20261016150052, 20261016170000, 20261026120000]; #266 says it lands with F074. Repeating posts exist for reminders ('every time', #952), so a weekly series could flood a week row once occurrences are rows [A]. The ticket is #600 (F074 criterion 6, one row per series).
